ambiguities: The frozen rules say a URL grants page identity rather than a proposition, but do not quantify how much verbatim quotation is required when a report gives an accurate nearby paraphrase. The comparisons credit explicit proposition-level paraphrases and do not credit a bare page or a citation proving only a different clause.

The atom dependency lists do not say that failure propagates mechanically. Later-atom challenges above are based only on the later proof actually consuming the same missing material premise, not merely on an earlier atom label being FAIL.
